question: What is the event-perturbed device envelope of the existing captured raked evaluation graph at three fixed later checks? This does not select an optimization.

schedule.per_arm_batch: 20 unchanged GpuSolver::iterate calls followed immediately by exactly one exploitability call; no wait, raw readback, state fingerprint, event query or logging between training and evaluation.
schedule.warm_capture: Both arms use the unmodified production exploitability method for20..140. Require eager evaluation at20, capture at40, and existing captured replay60..140. Inspect warmed/key1 graph-present state only after normal checks; do not add graph launches, clones, uploads or capture.
schedule.sampling: Ordinary arm continues production exploitability. Instrumented arm uses the identical already-captured branch with only two ordinary stream-event records added. It must reject missing/wrong warmed graph rather than silently warm/capture or fall back.
schedule.serialization: Run one whole arm batch through its normal root DTOH and CPU reduction before starting the other. No overlapping arms. All post-check verification occurs only after both matched arms finish.

events.creation: Once after constructors/admission and before warm training; outside all measured brackets. Keep owning context, stream, solver buffers and graph alive.
events.record_start: On the instrumented solver stream immediately before its normal eval_graphs[1].launch; preceding20 training iterations remain normally queued. No stream synchronize or raw copy before this point.
events.record_end: On the same stream immediately after the normal graph launch and before the existing root clone_dtoh.
events.readout: Only after the normal DTOH/CPU result completes and both arms end their host brackets; before handles are rerecorded at the next sampled checkpoint.
events.capture_policy: Events are outside capture. No external graph-event flags, graph editing, graph cloning or extra replay required.
events.query_validation: All three elapsed values finite and nonnegative; retain near-resolution values and mark them. Any CUDA error invalidates the diagnostic.
events.cleanup: Reuse checked success-path event/context cleanup and non-panicking best-effort error cleanup. Drain only after normal completion; events are destroyed before owning stream/context.

outer_usefulness.metric: host wall milliseconds for20 ordinary iterate calls plus that arm normal complete evaluation call, including root DTOH and CPU reduction
outer_usefulness.start: Immediately before first iterate in each sampled batch
outer_usefulness.end: Immediately after exploitability returns, before event query, equality check, logging, CPU store sync or fingerprint
outer_usefulness.failure: Preserve every sample and mark inconclusive for low-perturbation interpretation. No trimming, retuning, alternate placement, extra samples or extension.
outer_usefulness.limits: This matched whole-batch host distortion screen is not evaluation check wall time, not pure GPU time and not a bound on individual event interval bias.

exactness.exploit_anchor_bits: Both arms must match every20 anchor20..200 in anchors.json, including the same target crossing at200.
exactness.raw_arrays: Compare full raw bits of both players regrets/strategy/reach/weights plus discounts after BOTH evaluations have completed; bounded1M-float chunks. These are matched post-evaluation reaches, not pre-evaluation training reaches. Exclude uninitialized CFV scratch.
exactness.root_outputs: Compare all four logical downloaded evaluation root vectors/defined d_eval_roots content after normal completion; never use unknown CFV padding as an oracle.
exactness.cpu_stores: Then sync both arms to CPU and directly compare every q word and every scale bit of all four compressed arenas. This check is outside timing and does not mutate GPU learning state.
exactness.final200: Both complete state_fingerprint objects (all arena metadata/hashes and full root_strategy_bits) equal each other and immutable original/E015/E020 final object, in addition to direct full arm raw/q/scale equality.
exactness.no_early_drain: D045 raw-before-eval and explicit synchronize-before-check calls must NOT be reused. Any pre-eval download/synchronize at a sampled checkpoint is a protocol violation.

memory_lifetime.shared_spot: One Arc<Spot>; two independent CPU/GPU solver states, each retains its own stream/context ownership and all captured buffers.
memory_lifetime.admission: Reuse D045 checked dual-state VRAM/RAM admission before allocations and second-arm live-free recheck;2GiB device reserve,8GiB host reserve, at least16GiB available host RAM before shared Spot. Derive actual accepted E020 two-tone plan payload, not rainbow constants.
memory_lifetime.backups: No additional device snapshots; sequential host comparisons; no cross-solver graph or event handles.

minimal_future_implementation.status: Suggested scope only; no code prepared
minimal_future_implementation.method: Ordinary arm invokes accepted exploitability unchanged. At sampled points only, instrumented test helper mechanically copies accepted already-captured evaluation path, including identical denom/dot/root offsets/reduction expressions, and inserts two event record calls around the existing launch. Warm/capture is always performed by original method beforehand.
minimal_future_implementation.reuse: D045 fixture parsing/admission/checked sums, bounded raw and CPU exact comparison, fingerprint helper, event cleanup, root-owned build/run/provenance patterns. Remove training graph clone/node descriptor/instrumented iterate machinery entirely.
minimal_future_implementation.mechanical_review: Require source provenance for copied captured path and unchanged numeric statements; same logical graph/kernel descriptors at140, no node edits; accepted CUDA and every production method byte-identical. Inspect test inventory at actual implementation freeze.
minimal_future_implementation.future_execution: One ignored test invocation under existing GPU lock/live-idle/disk/provenance guards after separate root authorization and independent source/script review. Fixed primary evaluator, old binaries and all closed evidence stay immutable.

required_output: both arm host batch times and order at160/180/200
memory admission and actual source/binary provenance
warm/capture cadence evidence and checked cleanup outcome
interpretation: Evaluation-device envelope only: queued eval kernels and graph root copies, with possible scheduling/submission idle between events.
No CPU pair-weight/dot/root DTOH inside event interval.
No quality-check wall-time attribution, training/evaluation fraction, family or individual-kernel cost, native complete-solve fraction, removable headroom, speedup or acceptance claim.
Three fixed samples of one workload; do not extrapolate across configurations or use outer guard to claim per-component accuracy.
